lines.text: Judah was exiled to Babylon for unfaithfulness, and the first to resettle their cities were Israelites, priests, Levites, and temple servants.
The Benjamites came with 956 relatives, and the priests came with 1,760 relatives, able men for the service of God's house.
Shallum was chief of the gatekeepers, and 212 were chosen, appointed by David and Elijah the seer.
Gatekeepers stood on all four sides, relatives served for forty days, and the chief gatekeepers guarded the house at night.
Mattithiah the Levite was entrusted with baking the bread, and Kish was the father of Saul.
